metadata.description: Self-hosted take on Spotify's shunt plugin: hooks, Sonnet/Opus subagents and orchestration rules that keep big reads, boilerplate and diffs off the frontier model.

plugins.name: shunt
plugins.description: Blocks oversized reads and diff dumps, routes work to bulk-reader / code-writer / reviewer subagents, and injects orchestration rules plus /review and /task commands. No external services.
